title: Petropavlivska Borshchahivka clashes: Parents of injured 14-year-old face scrutiny by child services
summary: The Child Services Department has held a preventive meeting with the parents of a 14-year-old boy who was injured during the events in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka.

title: New phase of search operations begins in Puzhnyky, Ternopil region
summary: Ukrainian and Polish specialists are continuing the search for the remains of people killed during World War II on the site of the former village of Puzhnyky in the Ternopil region.

title: Russia stockpiles up to 700 ballistic missiles, several thousand cruise missiles – Ukrainian intelligence
summary: As of October 2026, Russia had stockpiled up to 700 ballistic missiles and several thousand cruise missiles.
